title: Jonathan G NDE 4333
content: This occurred during the middle of the month of May. I had gone to the emergency room at the Veterans Hospital on a Thursday afternoon with a chest pain that wouldn't go away. The next day they conducted a stress test, which I was unable to complete so it was chemically induced to speed up my heart for the test. The next morning, which was on a Saturday the Cardiologist stopped by my room, and did the usual stethoscope thing. He listening to my heart and told me that I was scheduled for an angioplasty/stent on Monday. A very blah breakfast was delivered when he was leaving and I started to eat a waffle when the chest pain began to get very intense. I kept pushing the wrong nurses call button and after a while when no one came I walked out to the nurses station which was close to my room concerning my situation. They of course said get back in your bed and all kinds of technicians, nurses and the doctor were there within moments. That's when for what I believe was a very brief moment I had a strange/unusual experience. All of those people attending me suddenly vanished and my mother was sitting on the left side of the bed beside me with my father standing by her. I didn't realize who they were at first because they were both very young late teens or early twenties. There were other people behind them. I couldn't focus on them because of a bright light coming from something like a worm hole/cornucopia/horn of plenty shaped object behind them. There were figures of people rushing out of it toward me but I couldn't tell who they were due to the extreme brightness of the light coming from that object. I then became distracted by figures to my right which were all my former pets (dogs and cats that had died) climbing over each other to get to me, they gave me the impression of me just getting home from a long trip as they seemed very excited to see me. I had time to glance back at my mom and then everything disappeared and all the hospital personnel were there treating me. I was rushed to the emergency room at a nearby cardiac facility where they told me the artery between my heart and lungs was almost completely blocked and a stent was put in with another stent done that Monday.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A bright light came from something "like a worm hole/cornucopia/horn of plenty shaped object" behind his young-looking parents, with figures rushing out of it toward him.

arrival.other_being_detail: Former pets (dogs and cats that had died); also "other people behind" his parents and "figures of people rushing out of it" (not identifiable).

environment.environment_other_detail: A very bright light from a "worm hole/cornucopia/horn of plenty shaped object."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encounter included deceased parents appearing young, deceased pets, and unidentified figures behind parents/rushing from a bright wormhole-like opening; then abrupt return to hospital scene.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Hospital scene shifted directly into a brief encounter with deceased loved ones/pets and a bright wormhole-like opening; no explicit OBE or life review; then immediate return to the hospital scene.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A "worm hole/cornucopia/horn of plenty shaped" bright opening with figures rushing out toward him; deceased pets crowding excitedly as if he had returned from a trip.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "All of those people attending me suddenly vanished and my mother was sitting on the left side of the bed beside me with my father standing by her."; "I couldn't focus on them because of a bright light coming from something like a worm hole/cornucopia/horn of plenty shaped object behind them."; "figures to my right which were all my former pets (dogs and cats that had died) climbing over each other to get to me"; "they gave me the impression of me just getting home from a long trip".
